The '''DC-15S''', also referred to as the '''DC-15 blaster''' and '''DC15 carbine''', was the [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] variant of [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech's]] [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], not to be confused with the DC-15A itself. This weapon was carried by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was also in service in the earlier [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
[[File:PhaseICloneTrooper3-Fathead.png|thumb|left|180px|A clone trooper wielding a DC-15S]]
Smaller in scale than the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], the DC-15S [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] lacked its larger cousin's range, but was easier to handle than its bulkier cousin with a higher rate of fire. The DC-15S also featured a [[Stock/Legends|folding stock]] for enhanced aiming with braced firing. The length of the trigger pull determined the firing setting (semiautomatic or automatic). This blaster was not a true [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]], but it could handle braced firing much better than its larger cousin, with more accuracy and less chance of overheating. DC-15 blasters fired charged [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] bolts, with [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] cartridges activated by power magazines (replaced by sliding them out of the side of the gun and inserting a new one) and projected down a magnetic accelerating barrel.

The gas cartridges always lasted for around 500 shots, due to the fact the DC-15S had no power settings, except for the nonlethal stun setting, while the power magazines lasted around 50. Many troops carried spare energizer packs on them, but due to the fragility and difficulty of replacing the tibanna cartridges in combat, few troops carried more than the one in their gun on them. Instead, the cartridges were replaced by the trooper in his spare time, by opening a hatch near the back of the weapon, popping out the old cartridge, inserting the new one, and closing the hatch.

They were extremely powerful weapons, especially in the hands of experienced [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and were more than capable of piercing heavy armor. This gun was known to be dual-wielded and sometimes held as a pistol. The blaster could also fire a [[Ascension cable|grappling cable]] which was attached to the butt of the folded stock, requiring the stock to be folded when using the cable. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and the [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent detachment]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] utilized this capability most noticeably during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], using them to scale the sheer cliff below their objective.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> This famous clone blaster was often used by [[Cody/Legends|Commander Cody]] of the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref><ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars" /> Additionally, the blaster had a stun setting, as shown by Boba Fett when he attacked [[CT-1477/Legends|CT-1477]] on the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']].<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref>

==History==
{{Expandsect}}
[[File:DC-15S_blaster.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] firing a DC-15S]]
The DC-15S was widely used by clone troopers during the Clone Wars,<ref name="Battlefront I">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> though most notably in the conflict's final days. It became increasingly common just before the Battle of Teth, though its popularity did decrease after the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. While its popularity would rise and decline, it was used extensively throughout the Clone Wars as both a primary and secondary weapon. While the longer range of the more powerful DC-15A blaster rifle was often preferable to the DC-15S, its shorter build made it useful in combat,high pressure rapid-fire, particularly in close-quarters battles. It could be set to a high pressure rapid-fire, as demonstrated by a member of the 212th Battalion on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. The DC-15S became more common during the later period of the war.

[[File:Confederacy_invades_Christophsis.png|thumb|left|250px|Christophsian resistance defending their home.]]
The weapon was used by the [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] resistance against the invading Separatists on their planet of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], however, all their attempts at fighting of the droid army failed until they were reinforced by the Republic.

The weapon was also carried by the bodyguards of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] Chairman [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] during their border dispute on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] with the native species, the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]].

[[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Trooper]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fordo]] was often seen dual wielding a pair of stockless DC-15s blaster carbines.

The design of the DC-15S would later be enhanced by BlasTech for the introduction of the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], commonly known as the "[[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] rifle".

Clone troopers stationed in close quarters environments would often use the weapon, such as the Kamino guards and the battles inside ships, probably to avoid damage to the surrounding areas.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RCCloneTrooperGeoKill.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A clone trooper holds a DC-15S at the Battle of Geonosis.]]
In the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', the DC-15S is used as a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].

The weapon somewhat resembles the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] which is based on the [[Wikipedia:British|British]] [[Wikipedia:Sterling submachine gun|Sterling L2A3 submachine gun]]. The DC-15S is the supposed precursor to the E-11 which came after it.

In [[Death Trap]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] mistakenly identifies a DC-15S as a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A]]. It is also misidentified as such in ''[[Star Wars: Battles for the Galaxy]]''.
